exposure: adipose tissue in endometrial samples (presence and proportion)
outcome: presence of adipose tissue in endometrial samples
cohort: A cohort of 23 patients (mean age 60.6 years) who had adipose tissue identified in their endometrial biopsy or curettage specimens over an 8-year period.
finding: While adipose tissue in endometrial specimens may indicate uterine perforation, its presence was not significantly associated with adverse outcomes or intraoperative detection in this cohort.
